calculators.title: Compound Annual Growth and Future Value Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Determine the future accumulated value of regular periodic investments or a single lump sum given an expected compound rate of return.
inputs: Annual expected rate of return as a percentage
outputs: Total interest or capital gains earned in rupees
calculators.formulaSpoken: Future value of lump sum equals principal multiplied by one plus the periodic interest rate raised to the power of total compounding periods. Future value of annuity additions equals periodic payment multiplied by the result of one plus periodic rate raised to the power of periods minus one, all divided by the periodic rate.
calculators.assumptions: Constant rate of return throughout the tenure without interim withdrawals or tax friction.
edgeCases: Zero percent return
Tenure of one month
Very high compounding frequency

calculators.title: Inflation-Adjusted Future Purchasing Power Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Calculate how much an existing sum or future cashflow will be worth in real present purchasing power terms after decades of domestic inflation.
inputs: Annual expected inflation rate as a percentage
outputs: Present purchasing power equivalent in rupees
calculators.formulaSpoken: Present purchasing power equals the future nominal amount divided by one plus the annual inflation rate raised to the power of the number of years.
calculators.assumptions: Uniform compounding rate of inflation across all consumer expenditure buckets.
edgeCases: Negative inflation (deflation)
Inflation exceeding return rate

calculators.title: Emergency Fund Adequacy and Liquidity Sizing Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Size an appropriate emergency liquidity buffer tailored to monthly fixed non-discretionary expenses, job volatility, and health coverage.
inputs: Monthly mandatory living expenses in rupees
Monthly debt EMI obligations in rupees
Number of financially dependent family members
Income stability category (salaried stable, single-earner private tech, freelancer/business)
outputs: Months of expenses covered (3 to 12 months)
Suggested allocation across savings account, sweep FDs, and liquid mutual funds
calculators.formulaSpoken: Recommended reserve equals the sum of monthly living expenses and loan EMIs multiplied by an income volatility risk multiplier ranging from three months for double-income stable households to twelve months for freelancers.
calculators.assumptions: No income earned during the emergency distress period.
edgeCases: Zero loan EMIs
Highly variable monthly expenditure

calculators.title: Personal Net Worth and Balance Sheet Architecture
calculators.userProblem: Aggregate total liquid, invested, and physical assets against all secured and unsecured liabilities to compute true net financial solvency.
inputs: Equity mutual funds and listed stocks
calculators.formulaSpoken: Net worth equals total gross tangible and financial assets minus total outstanding debt liabilities.
calculators.assumptions: Market valuations are realistic conservative estimates rather than speculative inflated prices.
edgeCases: Negative net worth where unsecured debt exceeds total assets

calculators.title: Debt Payoff Avalanche versus Snowball Comparator
calculators.userProblem: Compare total interest savings and debt elimination timelines between highest-interest avalanche payoff and smallest-balance snowball payoff.
inputs: List of debts with outstanding balances in rupees
Minimum monthly payments for each debt
Extra monthly debt payoff budget in rupees
outputs: Total interest paid in rupees under each strategy
calculators.formulaSpoken: Under avalanche, extra funds are channeled to the loan with the highest annual percentage rate while paying minimums on others; under snowball, extra funds target the smallest principal balance first.
calculators.assumptions: No additional debt incurred during the repayment horizon.
edgeCases: Identical interest rates across debts
Extra payment less than total minimums

calculators.title: Loan Amortization and Equated Monthly Installment (EMI) Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Calculate monthly installment, total interest payable, and the exact split between principal and interest for any retail loan.
inputs: Annual interest rate as a percentage
Loan tenure in years or months
outputs: Total interest payable over loan life in rupees
calculators.formulaSpoken: Monthly installment equals principal multiplied by monthly interest rate multiplied by the factor of one plus monthly rate raised to the power of number of months, all divided by the factor of one plus monthly rate raised to the power of months minus one.
calculators.assumptions: Fixed rate of interest throughout the loan tenure without missed installments.
edgeCases: Zero percent promotional interest
One-year short tenure

calculators.title: Home Loan Prepayment and Tenure Reduction Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Evaluate the financial impact of periodic lump sum or increased monthly prepayments on total interest reduction and tenure shortening.
inputs: Original home loan amount in rupees
Current outstanding principal balance in rupees
Prepayment amount in rupees (one-time or annual recurring)
Preference: reduce monthly EMI or shorten loan tenure
outputs: Number of years and months shaved off loan tenure
calculators.formulaSpoken: Prepayment directly deducts from outstanding principal, recalculating future interest on the reduced balance and shortening the compounding amortization schedule.
calculators.assumptions: Zero prepayment penalty under RBI rules for individual floating rate retail loans.
edgeCases: Prepayment exceeding outstanding balance
calculators.taxSensitivity: Medium - home loan interest tax deductions under Section 24(b) decrease as interest declines.

calculators.title: Bank Fixed Deposit Quarterly Compounding Maturity Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Calculate exact maturity proceeds and interest accrued on commercial bank fixed deposits using RBI quarterly compounding standards.
inputs: Annual interest rate as a percentage
Customer category (general citizen, senior citizen with 0.50% markup)
calculators.formulaSpoken: Maturity value equals principal multiplied by one plus the annual interest rate divided by four, all raised to the power of four multiplied by the tenure in years.
calculators.assumptions: Interest is compounded on a quarterly rest basis as mandated by RBI master directions for term deposits exceeding six months.
edgeCases: Tenure under ninety days (simple interest applies)
Leap year day counts
calculators.taxSensitivity: High - interest taxed at marginal slab rates with TDS under Section 194A.

calculators.title: Recurring Deposit Maturity and Compounding Engine
calculators.userProblem: Compute maturity returns on monthly recurring deposits using Indian banking quarterly compounding formulas.
inputs: Annual interest rate as a percentage
calculators.formulaSpoken: Maturity value is computed by compounding each monthly installment from its deposit date to the end of the term using quarterly compounding factors.
calculators.assumptions: Prompt monthly deposit without installment default penalties.
edgeCases: Tenure less than six months
Defaulted monthly installments
calculators.taxSensitivity: High - interest subject to Section 194A TDS and slab taxation.

calculators.title: Bond Yield to Maturity (YTM) and Clean/Dirty Price Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Determine the true annualized Yield to Maturity (YTM) of a dated Government Security or corporate bond based on its market clean price and accrued interest.
inputs: Face value in rupees (typically 100 for G-Secs or 1000 for NCDs)
Annual coupon rate as a percentage
outputs: Yield to Maturity (YTM) as an annualized percentage
calculators.formulaSpoken: Yield to maturity is the internal rate of return that equates the present value of all future semi-annual coupon payments and terminal face value repayment to the bond dirty market price.
calculators.assumptions: All coupons reinvested at the identical yield to maturity without default.
edgeCases: Zero coupon bond
Clean price trading at extreme premium or discount
calculators.taxSensitivity: High - coupon interest taxed as other income; capital gains taxed under Finance Act 2024.

calculators.title: Bond Macaulay and Modified Duration Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Calculate the interest rate sensitivity and price volatility of a bond portfolio when RBI repo rates shift.
outputs: Estimated price change for a 50 bps, 100 bps, and 200 bps yield shift
calculators.formulaSpoken: Macaulay duration equals the sum of present-value-weighted cashflow times divided by bond price. Modified duration equals Macaulay duration divided by one plus yield divided by coupon frequency.
calculators.assumptions: Flat yield curve shift across all maturities.
edgeCases: Zero coupon bond where duration equals maturity

calculators.title: Tax-Adjusted Equivalent Yield Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Compare after-tax yields of taxable bank fixed deposits, corporate bonds, and tax-exempt instruments like PPF and SGB.
inputs: Taxable instrument gross interest rate as a percentage
Tax-free instrument interest rate as a percentage
Taxpayer marginal income tax bracket (including surcharge and 4% cess)
outputs: Net after-tax yield of taxable instrument
Tax-equivalent yield required on taxable instrument to match tax-free product
Clear recommendation on which product delivers superior net cashflow
calculators.formulaSpoken: Net after-tax yield equals gross interest rate multiplied by one minus the marginal tax rate. Tax-equivalent yield equals tax-free rate divided by one minus the marginal tax rate.
calculators.assumptions: Marginal tax slab remains stable over the investment horizon.
edgeCases: Zero percent tax slab where gross equals net
calculators.taxSensitivity: Critical - direct comparison of after-tax yields.

calculators.title: Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) Compounding Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Project the accumulated wealth, total capital invested, and capital gains from monthly equity or debt mutual fund SIPs.
inputs: Expected annual rate of return as a percentage
Optional annual step-up percentage (e.g., 10% annual increase)
outputs: Purchasing power in today's rupees after inflation
calculators.formulaSpoken: Each monthly installment compounds over its remaining months using the periodic monthly rate derived from the annual expected return, aggregated across total months.
calculators.assumptions: Returns are modeled as an average compound annual growth rate without sequence-of-returns volatility.
edgeCases: Negative expected returns
Zero step-up vs aggressive step-up
calculators.taxSensitivity: Medium - gross corpus projection before Section 112A capital gains tax.

calculators.title: Lump Sum vs SIP Multi-Scenario Analyzer
calculators.userProblem: Evaluate whether deploying a large cash sum as a lump sum immediately or spreading via a 12-month Systematic Transfer Plan (STP) produces superior returns under differing market valuation regimes.
inputs: Available lump sum amount in rupees
Liquid fund debt yield during STP period
STP deployment duration in months (6, 12, 18 months)
Market scenario (bull run, range-bound, immediate correction)
outputs: Final wealth under immediate lump sum
Maximum drawdown experienced in each strategy
Recommendation based on current market PE ratio
calculators.formulaSpoken: Lump sum compounds continuously at equity CAGR. Under STP, capital starts in a liquid fund earning daily interest while fixed tranches transfer monthly into equities, averaging market entry costs.
calculators.assumptions: Liquid fund returns remain stable during the transfer phase.
edgeCases: STP duration longer than total investment tenure
calculators.taxSensitivity: Medium - STP triggers capital gains on debt fund units transferred each month.

calculators.title: Mutual Fund Expense Ratio Wealth Erosion Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Quantify the exact rupee loss in terminal wealth caused by investing in a Regular mutual fund plan paying distributor commissions versus a Direct plan over 10 to 30 years.
inputs: Gross scheme portfolio return before expenses
outputs: Total rupee wealth lost to distributor commissions
Percentage reduction in final retirement corpus
calculators.formulaSpoken: Net return for Direct plan equals gross return minus Direct TER. Net return for Regular plan equals gross return minus Regular TER. Both are projected across the tenure and compared.
calculators.assumptions: Expense ratios remain constant over the tenure.
edgeCases: Zero expense difference (index fund vs index fund)

calculators.title: Extended Internal Rate of Return (XIRR) Engine
calculators.userProblem: Calculate the precise annualized internal rate of return for irregular, non-periodic cash inflows and redemptions in mutual funds or equity portfolios.
inputs: List of transaction amounts (negative for investments, positive for redemptions/current value)
outputs: Net profit or loss in rupees
Comparison against benchmark index CAGR over identical dates
calculators.formulaSpoken: XIRR is the rate of return that equates the sum of all cash flows discounted to day zero by dividing each cash flow by one plus the rate raised to the power of the exact day count fraction divided by 365, to zero.
calculators.assumptions: Accurate transaction dates and complete accounting for all interim dividend or redemption cash flows.
edgeCases: Transactions occurring on the exact same date
All negative cashflows without terminal value

calculators.title: Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) and Corpus Longevity Engine
calculators.userProblem: Model monthly income withdrawals from a mutual fund corpus to determine how many years the portfolio will last before exhaustion.
inputs: Annual expected portfolio return as a percentage
Annual inflation adjustment for withdrawals percentage (e.g., 6% step-up)
calculators.formulaSpoken: Each month, the remaining corpus earns one month of returns, after which the inflation-indexed monthly withdrawal is deducted from principal.
calculators.assumptions: Constant monthly returns without sharp negative sequence-of-returns shocks.
edgeCases: Withdrawal exceeding annual portfolio return (rapid depletion)
Corpus growing faster than withdrawals
calculators.taxSensitivity: High - capital gains apply solely to the capital gain portion of redeemed units.

calculators.title: Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Equity Valuation Model
calculators.userProblem: Estimate the intrinsic fair value per share of a publicly listed Indian company by projecting and discounting its Free Cash Flows to Firm (FCFF).
inputs: Current Free Cash Flow to Firm in Crore rupees
Expected terminal growth rate percentage (typically 4-5% in India)
Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) percentage
Cash and cash equivalents in Crore rupees
outputs: Intrinsic fair value per share in rupees
Margin of safety percentage relative to current market price
calculators.formulaSpoken: Enterprise value equals the sum of discounted projected free cash flows for five years plus the terminal value discounted to present value. Equity value equals enterprise value minus net debt.
calculators.assumptions: WACC remains constant and terminal growth does not exceed Indian long-term nominal GDP growth.
edgeCases: Negative free cash flow in base year
WACC lower than terminal growth rate (invalid model)

calculators.title: Dividend Discount Model (Gordon Growth Model)
calculators.userProblem: Value stable dividend-paying companies (such as public sector undertakings or utilities) using expected perpetual dividend growth.
inputs: Latest dividend per share in rupees
Required rate of return (cost of equity) percentage
outputs: Intrinsic stock value per share in rupees
calculators.formulaSpoken: Intrinsic share value equals next year's dividend divided by the difference between the required rate of return and the perpetual dividend growth rate.
calculators.assumptions: Dividend growth rate is strictly lower than the required rate of return.
edgeCases: Zero dividend paying growth companies (model inapplicable)
Growth rate equal to or greater than required return

calculators.title: Return on Invested Capital (ROIC) and Economic Moat Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Calculate a business's true economic return on capital to identify whether it generates sustainable shareholder value above its cost of capital.
inputs: Net Operating Profit After Tax (NOPAT) in Crore rupees
Total shareholders' equity in Crore rupees
Total interest-bearing debt in Crore rupees
Cash and non-operating investments in Crore rupees
Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) percentage
outputs: Economic Value Added (EVA) spread percentage (ROIC minus WACC)
calculators.formulaSpoken: Invested capital equals total debt plus equity minus non-operating cash. Return on invested capital equals net operating profit after tax divided by invested capital.
calculators.assumptions: Operating leases and capitalization of R&D are treated consistently.
edgeCases: Negative invested capital where working capital is highly negative (asset-light moats)

calculators.title: Expected Credit Loss (ECL) and Loan Portfolio Loss Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Model loan portfolio default losses across Probability of Default (PD), Exposure at Default (EAD), and Loss Given Default (LGD).
inputs: Total loan portfolio balance in rupees
Probability of default percentage across borrower cohorts
Loss given default percentage (100% minus expected collateral recovery)
outputs: Capital provision required under RBI prudential norms
calculators.formulaSpoken: Expected credit loss equals the mathematical product of Probability of Default multiplied by Loss Given Default multiplied by Exposure at Default.
calculators.assumptions: Independent default events across diversified borrower pools.
edgeCases: One hundred percent probability of default (Stage 3 non-performing assets)

calculators.title: P2P Lending Net Realized Return and Break-Even Default Engine
calculators.userProblem: Calculate the true net investor return from peer-to-peer lending after accounting for platform fees, cash drag, non-performing loans, and slab taxes.
inputs: Average recovery rate on defaulted loans percentage (e.g., 15%)
Uninvested cash drag percentage of portfolio
outputs: Break-even default rate where investor capital starts eroding
calculators.formulaSpoken: Net realized return equals gross interest minus platform fees minus net credit losses from defaults, adjusted for cash drag on idle funds.
calculators.assumptions: No platform insolvency or fraud events.
edgeCases: Default rate exceeding gross interest rate (capital loss)
calculators.taxSensitivity: Critical - P2P interest is fully taxable at slab rates without indexation or concession.

calculators.title: Section 115BAC New vs Old Tax Regime Comprehensive Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Determine the exact direct tax liability and net take-home pay under both the Old Tax Regime and Section 115BAC New Tax Regime for any income level.
inputs: Section 80C investments (PPF, EPF, ELSS up to ₹1.5L)
Section 24(b) self-occupied housing loan interest (up to ₹2L)
outputs: Total tax liability under Old Regime in rupees
Total tax liability under New Regime in rupees
Clear recommendation on which regime saves more money
calculators.formulaSpoken: Computes taxable income under Old Regime by subtracting standard deduction, HRA, 80C, 80D, and housing interest, applying progressive 5%, 20%, 30% slabs plus cess. Computes New Regime income by subtracting standard deduction and corporate NPS, applying 115BAC slabs with Section 87A rebate.
calculators.assumptions: Assessment Year 2025-26 rules under Finance (No. 2) Act 2024.
edgeCases: Taxable income between ₹7,00,000 and ₹7,27,770 (marginal relief under Section 87A)
Incomes exceeding ₹50 Lakh triggering surcharge

calculators.title: Capital Gains Tax Calculator Post-Finance Act 2024
calculators.userProblem: Compute short-term and long-term capital gains tax across listed equity, mutual funds, real estate, and unlisted securities under post-July 23, 2024 rules.
inputs: Asset type (listed equity/mutual fund, unlisted shares, residential property, debt fund)
Eligible improvement costs and transfer expenses
For pre-July 23 2024 property: choice of indexation with 20% tax or no indexation with 12.5% tax
outputs: Section 112A exemption applied (up to ₹1.25 Lakh for listed equity)
Total tax payable in rupees (20% for STCG, 12.5% for LTCG)
calculators.formulaSpoken: Determines holding period against statutory thresholds (12 months for listed equity, 24 months for property and unlisted equity). Applies 20% rate for Section 111A STCG and 12.5% rate for Section 112A LTCG beyond ₹1.25 Lakh.
calculators.assumptions: Transactions executed on or after July 23, 2024.
edgeCases: Property bought before 2001 utilizing April 1, 2001 fair market value
Capital losses eligible for 8-year carry-forward

calculators.title: Advance Tax Schedule and Sections 234A/234B/234C Interest Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Compute mandatory advance tax quarterly installments and determine penal interest under Sections 234A, 234B, and 234C for delayed or deficient tax payments.
inputs: Estimated annual net tax liability after TDS/TCS
Actual advance tax payments made on or before June 15, Sept 15, Dec 15, and March 15
Date of filing Income Tax Return
outputs: Advance tax shortfall for each quarter
Section 234C interest (1% per month on quarterly deferment)
Section 234B interest (1% per month on shortfall below 90%)
Section 234A interest for delayed ITR filing
Total statutory interest payable in rupees
calculators.formulaSpoken: Verifies that cumulative advance tax meets 15% by June, 45% by September, 75% by December, and 100% by March. Penalizes deficiencies at one percent simple interest per month under Section 234C, and shortfall below 90% at one percent per month from April 1 under Section 234B.
calculators.assumptions: Net tax liability after TDS exceeds ₹10,000 threshold.
edgeCases: Advance tax shortfall resulting from unpredictable capital gains or lottery income

calculators.title: Retirement Corpus and Pension Accumulation Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Calculate total retirement corpus required at age 60 factoring in life expectancy, post-retirement inflation, and investment returns.
inputs: Current monthly living expenditure in rupees
outputs: Monthly expenditure required at retirement date in rupees
Total lump sum retirement corpus required in rupees
Monthly SIP required today to achieve target corpus
calculators.formulaSpoken: Projects current monthly expenses to retirement age using pre-retirement inflation. Calculates retirement corpus using capital exhaustion formula where real post-retirement return is derived from dividing one plus nominal return by one plus inflation, minus one.
calculators.assumptions: Full financial independence without dependence on family or government pensions.
edgeCases: Post-retirement inflation equal to or greater than investment returns

calculators.title: Residential Property Gross and Net Rental Yield Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Determine the true net rental yield of an Indian residential property after property taxes, maintenance, vacancy losses, and management friction.
inputs: Stamp duty and registration fees in rupees
Interior and furnishing costs in rupees
Monthly society maintenance paid by owner in rupees
Annual municipal property tax in rupees
Expected vacancy periods in months per year
Annual maintenance and repairs budget in rupees
outputs: Total all-inclusive property capital investment in rupees
calculators.formulaSpoken: Gross yield equals annualized rent divided by purchase price. Net yield equals annual rent minus vacancy loss minus society maintenance minus property tax minus repair costs, all divided by total capital outlay including stamp duty and furnishing.
calculators.assumptions: Property value remains stable over the calculation year.
edgeCases: Zero vacancy over five years
Negative net operating income during tenant transitions
calculators.taxSensitivity: Medium - rental income taxed under 'Income from house property' with 30% standard deduction under Section 24(a).

calculators.title: Buy versus Rent Multi-Decadal Financial Model
calculators.userProblem: Conduct a mathematically rigorous financial comparison between buying residential real estate with a mortgage versus renting and investing the down payment and EMI surplus in diversified equity index funds.
inputs: Monthly rent for equivalent property in rupees
Expected equity mutual fund CAGR percentage
outputs: Total net worth at end of horizon under Buy strategy in rupees
Total net worth under Rent and Invest strategy in rupees
Clear mathematical winner and surplus wealth generated
Break-even year where buying overtakes renting
calculators.formulaSpoken: Tracks two parallel financial trajectories: Buy strategy builds property equity through debt amortization and home price appreciation minus maintenance, property tax, and mortgage interest; Rent strategy invests initial down payment and monthly EMI-versus-rent cashflow savings into compounding equity mutual funds.
calculators.assumptions: Consistent investment discipline under the Rent and Invest strategy without spending the cashflow surplus.
edgeCases: Zero property appreciation
Hyper-inflation in residential rents
calculators.taxSensitivity: High - models Section 24(b) housing loan interest deduction versus equity capital gains tax.

calculators.title: Business Break-Even and Contribution Margin Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Calculate minimum sales volume and revenue required for an Indian business to cover all fixed and variable operating costs.
inputs: Total monthly fixed costs in rupees (rent, salaries, utilities, software)
Unit variable cost in rupees (raw materials, shipping, payment gateway fees)
outputs: Contribution margin per unit in rupees
Margin of safety percentage at current sales volume
calculators.formulaSpoken: Contribution margin per unit equals selling price minus unit variable cost. Break-even volume in units equals total fixed costs divided by contribution margin per unit. Break-even revenue equals fixed costs divided by contribution margin ratio.
calculators.assumptions: Linear cost behavior within the relevant operating volume range.
edgeCases: Variable costs exceeding selling price (negative contribution margin)

calculators.title: Working Capital and Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) Engine
calculators.userProblem: Measure the number of days a commercial enterprise takes to convert inventory and operational investments into realized cash inflows.
inputs: Annual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) in rupees
Average accounts receivable balance in rupees
Average accounts payable balance in rupees
outputs: Days Sales of Inventory (DSI) in days
Working capital financing required in rupees
calculators.formulaSpoken: Days sales of inventory equals average inventory divided by COGS multiplied by 365. Days sales outstanding equals accounts receivable divided by revenue multiplied by 365. Days payable outstanding equals accounts payable divided by COGS multiplied by 365. Cash conversion cycle equals DSI plus DSO minus DPO.
calculators.assumptions: Uniform sales and purchasing velocity throughout the financial year.
edgeCases: Negative cash conversion cycle where supplier credit finances the entire business (Amazon/retail model)

calculators.title: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) to Lifetime Value (LTV) Ratio Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Assess the unit economic viability and marketing capital efficiency of an e-commerce, consumer startup, or B2B software venture.
inputs: Total sales and marketing expenditure over period in rupees
Number of new customers acquired in period
Average order value or monthly subscription in rupees
Customer churn rate percentage per month or year
calculators.formulaSpoken: CAC equals total marketing expenses divided by customers acquired. LTV equals average revenue per customer multiplied by gross margin divided by churn rate. LTV-to-CAC ratio divides customer lifetime value by acquisition cost.
calculators.assumptions: Customer churn rate is representative and stable.
edgeCases: Zero churn rate (infinite theoretical LTV)
CAC exceeding total customer lifetime revenue

calculators.title: Emergency Fund Burn Rate vs Cash Drag Optimizer
calculators.userProblem: Balance adequate liquid cash reserves against the inflation drag of holding excessive idle cash.
outputs: Annual purchasing power loss from cash drag in rupees
Optimized allocation across sweep FDs and liquid funds
calculators.formulaSpoken: Surplus cash equals total cash minus essential expenses multiplied by safety months. Cash drag equals surplus cash multiplied by the difference between inflation and savings interest.
calculators.assumptions: Inflation remains above savings account yield.
edgeCases: Negative surplus where cash is inadequate

calculators.title: Human Capital Valuation and Term Life Insurance Sizing Engine
calculators.userProblem: Determine the exact life insurance sum assured needed to replace future economic earning power for dependants.
inputs: Expected real income growth rate percentage
Future major goal costs in rupees (children's education)
outputs: Present value of human capital in rupees
Recommended term insurance sum assured in rupees
Adequacy check against existing life cover
calculators.formulaSpoken: Human capital value equals discounted present value of annual earnings to retirement. Sum assured equals human capital plus debt liabilities plus future lump sum goals minus existing financial assets.
calculators.assumptions: Family requires 70% to 80% income replacement in event of premature mortality.
edgeCases: Retirement age reached (human capital reaches zero)

calculators.title: Sweep Account Interest Optimization and Auto-Liquidation Modeler
calculators.userProblem: Calculate incremental interest earned by enabling automated sweep-in fixed deposit facilities on savings accounts.
inputs: Sweep fixed deposit interest rate percentage
Average frequency of auto-liquidation withdrawals per month
outputs: Incremental annual interest earned in rupees
Break-even threshold where sweep benefits exceed premature penalty costs
calculators.formulaSpoken: Incremental interest equals average balance in sweep FD multiplied by the spread between term deposit and savings rates, minus premature liquidation interest penalties.
calculators.assumptions: Bank enforces LIFO (last in first out) liquidation on sweep term deposits.
edgeCases: Balance rarely exceeding threshold
calculators.taxSensitivity: High - interest taxed at slab rates under Section 194A.

calculators.title: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS) Quarterly Cashflow Engine
calculators.userProblem: Project quarterly interest payouts and tax withholding from government Senior Citizens Savings Scheme investments.
inputs: Deposit principal in rupees (up to ₹30 Lakh cap)
TDS declaration status (Form 15H submitted vs standard TDS)
outputs: Quarterly guaranteed interest payout in rupees
Annual total interest income in rupees
calculators.formulaSpoken: Quarterly interest equals principal multiplied by annual statutory rate divided by four, paid automatically on the first day of April, July, October, and January.
calculators.assumptions: Interest rate locked for the 5-year tenure at the rate prevailing on account opening date.
edgeCases: Deposit exceeding statutory ₹30 Lakh ceiling
calculators.taxSensitivity: High - interest taxable as income from other sources with Section 80TTB deduction up to ₹50,000 for senior citizens.

calculators.title: Mutual Fund Portfolio Overlap and Factor Diversification Index
calculators.userProblem: Measure the portfolio holdings overlap percentage between two equity mutual fund schemes to eliminate redundant fee drag.
inputs: Scheme A stock holdings and portfolio weights
Scheme B stock holdings and portfolio weights
outputs: Unique stock count in Scheme A and Scheme B
calculators.formulaSpoken: Overlap percentage equals the sum of the minimum weights of each common stock across both schemes divided by the total combined portfolio weights.
calculators.assumptions: Monthly portfolio factsheet disclosures are accurate.
edgeCases: Identical schemes from different fund houses (90%+ overlap)

calculators.title: ETF Tracking Difference and Slippage Impact Calculator
calculators.userProblem: Calculate true investor return slippage in Exchange Traded Funds relative to the benchmark index and equivalent index mutual funds.
inputs: ETF secondary market traded price return percentage
Annual transaction brokerage and exchange turnover fees
outputs: Total cost of ownership comparison between ETF and Index Fund
calculators.formulaSpoken: Tracking difference equals index total return minus ETF NAV return. Slippage equals ETF NAV return minus investor actual executed trade price return.
calculators.assumptions: Investor trades during market hours with prevailing bid-ask spreads.
edgeCases: Extreme market volatility sessions with wide market maker spreads

calculators.title: Enterprise Value to EBITDA Multiple Sensitivity Model
calculators.userProblem: Evaluate fair enterprise and equity value across cyclical industrial or manufacturing companies using EBITDA multiples.
inputs: Annual projected EBITDA in Crore rupees
Cash and liquid investments in Crore rupees
outputs: Implied Enterprise Value in Crore rupees
Implied Equity Value in Crore rupees
Target stock price per share in rupees
Sensitivity table across multiples plus or minus two turns
calculators.formulaSpoken: Enterprise value equals EBITDA multiplied by the EV-to-EBITDA multiple. Equity value equals enterprise value minus total debt plus cash minus minority interest. Target price divides equity value by shares outstanding.
calculators.assumptions: EBITDA is adjusted for one-off exceptional gains or non-recurring expenses.
edgeCases: Negative EBITDA (model inapplicable)

calculators.title: Borrower Concentration and Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI)
calculators.userProblem: Assess concentration and single-name exposure risk across private credit, bond, or P2P portfolios.
inputs: List of loan or bond exposures in rupees
outputs: Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) score from zero to 10,000
Concentration risk rating (well-diversified, moderately concentrated, highly concentrated)
calculators.formulaSpoken: HHI is calculated by taking the percentage share of each individual exposure in the portfolio, squaring each percentage, and summing all the squared percentages.
calculators.assumptions: No hidden parent-subsidiary cross-guarantees linking separate borrower entities.
edgeCases: Single borrower representing 100% of portfolio (HHI equals 10,000)

calculators.title: Presumptive Taxation Section 44ADA vs Regular Books Comparison
calculators.userProblem: Determine whether a freelancing software engineer or professional saves more tax under Section 44ADA presumptive taxation or regular accounting books with audit.
inputs: Gross professional receipts in rupees (up to ₹75 Lakh)
Actual business operating expenses in rupees
Regime choice (Old vs New Regime Section 115BAC)
outputs: Presumptive taxable profit under Section 44ADA (50% of gross)
Actual taxable profit under regular books
Total tax payable under regular books
Tax difference and statutory tax audit exemption benefit
calculators.formulaSpoken: Under Section 44ADA, taxable professional income is deemed to be fifty percent of gross receipts without maintaining detailed ledgers. Under regular books, actual recorded expenses are deducted from gross receipts.
calculators.assumptions: Gross receipts do not exceed ₹75 Lakh (provided cash receipts do not exceed 5%).
edgeCases: Actual expenses exceeding fifty percent of gross receipts

calculators.title: Commercial Real Estate Cap Rate and Net Operating Income (NOI) Engine
calculators.userProblem: Evaluate the investment yield and commercial property valuation based on Net Operating Income and capitalization rates.
inputs: Gross potential rental income in Crore rupees
Property operating expenses in Crore rupees
outputs: Effective Gross Income (EGI) in Crore rupees
Net Operating Income (NOI) in Crore rupees
Fair commercial property valuation in Crore rupees
Debt service coverage ratio (DSCR) if mortgaged
calculators.formulaSpoken: NOI equals effective gross income minus property operating expenses. Property valuation equals Net Operating Income divided by the capitalization rate.
calculators.assumptions: Capitalization rate reflects prevailing institutional yields in the specific micromarket.
edgeCases: Operating expenses exceeding gross rent

calculators.title: Venture Capital Post-Money Valuation and Founder Dilution Matrix
calculators.userProblem: Calculate founder equity dilution, option pool expansion, and post-money valuation across multi-stage startup funding rounds.
inputs: New investment amount in Crore rupees
Unallocated Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) pool expansion percentage
calculators.formulaSpoken: Post-money valuation equals pre-money valuation plus new investment. Investor ownership equals new investment divided by post-money valuation. Founder post-round ownership multiplies existing share by one minus investor share minus option pool increase.
calculators.assumptions: Investment is made via equity or Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS).
edgeCases: Down round where post-money valuation is lower than prior round post-money
